J. Rockett Audio Designs GTO Overdrive - Precision Tuned Instruments for Every Musician Up to 50% OFF – Limited Time Only! Shop Now Home Shop Contact us Terms & Conditions 0 J. Rockett Audio Designs GTO Overdrive Home  /  Effects  / J. Rockett Audio Designs GTO Overdrive J. Rockett Audio Designs GTO Overdrive The new GTO is the latest design coop with Guthrie Trapp. The original was sort of the Nashville favorite, recreating the old Nobels ODR-1. A great sound in itself but Guthrie wanted more;-)The new GTO has a much tighter bottom, less gain and more cut in t $ 99.50 $ 199.00 Add to cart Payment: Security Policy (Safe & Secure Shopping Guaranteed) Delivery Policy (Fast & Reliable Shipping) Return Policy (5-Day Money-Back Guarantee) Description Reviews Shipping Policy The new GTO is the latest design coop with Guthrie Trapp. The original was sort of the Nashville favorite, recreating the old Nobels ODR-1. A great sound in itself but Guthrie wanted more;-) The new GTO has a much tighter bottom, less gain and more cut in the mix. It can go from super mild to a really nice, dynamic OD feel. This pedal has compression but in a great way. You can use it as a clean boost and EQ or you can bring in the dirt. Level Interactively controls the overall output. The more gain, the louder it will become so you have to use the two in conjunction Gain Controls the gain level but also creates compression and feel. It blends with the clean signal so you can really find interesting sounds Accent Controls the cut through the mix, the top end and the bite Warmth Controls the bottom end but is also very interactive with the Accent control. You can really fatten up the mids but use the accent to keep it from getting woofy Dimensions: 4.00 x 2.30 9 volt Negative tip adaptor and a 5.5mm x 2.1mm jack. 9 volt Battery True Bypass Reviews There are no reviews yet. Rockett Audio Designs GTO Back to results J. Rockett Audio Designs GTO Overdrive Guthrie Trapp signature overdrive capturing his countrified Tele crunch and sparkle. J. Rockett collaborated with Nashville guitarist Guthrie Trapp on the GTO, designed to capture his signature countrified Telecaster tone. The circuit delivers that spanky, chicken-pickin' crunch that defines modern country guitar. The overdrive is voiced for single-coil guitars, particularly Telecasters, with the sparkle and cut needed for country and Americana styles. It cleans up beautifully with guitar volume, essential for the dynamic country picking Trapp is known for. Level, Gain, and Tone shape the country overdrive. The GTO excels at that percussive, articulate drive that lets hybrid-picked runs speak clearly. True bypass switching.
